name: acceler-local
description: Local marketplace hosting the Acceler B2B pre-sales and post-sales/delivery plugins.

plugins.name: acceler-presales
plugins.description: Acceler B2B Pre-Sales orchestrator — discovery → similar precedents → proposal doc → proposal deck (pre-sales pitch) → pricing → instructors. Powered by the Acceler Knowledge Graph. Delivery/post-sales artifacts live in the companion acceler-post-sales plugin below.

plugins.name: acceler-post-sales
plugins.description: Acceler B2B Post-Sales / Delivery orchestrator — session deck (live delivery HTML deck) → session recap (post-delivery learner recap) → session recap report (post-delivery stakeholder analytics).
